- Each line is a single word using only lowercase letters a–z (no spaces, digits, or punctuation).
- Reading the first letter of each word from top to bottom spells `FROND`.
- Each word is strictly longer than the word on the line above it.
- Exactly one of the five words is a palindrome (reads the same forwards and backwards).
- The total number of letters across all five words is a multiple of 5.
